source.title: На М-12 «Восток» вводятся новые абонементы на проезд по участку обхода Нижнекамска и Набережных Челнов
source.retrievalMethod: Official page rendered through web reader; source lines 114–118

interpretation.formalCategoryIMappingBasis: The official page calls the class passenger cars; the owner reports Order54 visually maps Category I to 230 RUB. The inaccessible PDF bytes are not locally verified or hashed.
interpretation.paymentModeBasis: The page distinguishes standard tariff from the maximum T-pass loyalty discount. Equal base tariff across cash/card/listed transponders is owner-reported from the Order54 visual reading, not independently confirmed from retained PDF bytes.
limitations: This is a structured extract of rendered official-page text, not original HTML bytes or the Order54 PDF.
Do not apply 195.50 RUB as the base transponder tariff; it is explicitly the maximum loyalty-discount amount.
